Create the ultimate Skulls and Skeletons composition across the full upper back. Two enormous skeletal figures occupy opposite sides of the body one reaching upward and one descending while their rib cages curve with the shoulder blades. Between them floats a colossal fragmented skull whose sections separate into architectural ruins tree roots black birds and geometric bone structures. A tiny living human figure stands inside one eye socket looking outward establishing impossible scale. Deep Blackwork anchors the composition while ivory bone crimson reflected light and subtle cobalt atmosphere create dimensional separation. Every transformation must grow logically from skeletal anatomy. The piece should feel simultaneously anatomical medieval surreal emotional and contemporary without becoming a random collage
